snippet.title: Annelids: Worms battle - Official trailer
snippet.description:
Official game trailer of Annelids: Worms battle.

Get annelids for Android and iOS:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=cz.gdmt.AnnelidsDemo
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/annelids-worms-battle/id964832564

Evil worms battle in fully destructible underground world.
• Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, Conquest and King of the Hill game modes.
• Single player with great artificial intelligence.
• Multiplayer over wifi. Up to 6 players. Requires one time fee.
• Procedurally generated maps.
• 31 missions, 13 maps, 26 unique weapons and 9 secret ones.

Music: Step by step - oglsdl (CC BY 3.0)
(http://audiofarm.org/audiofiles/20220)
